question: Have they made any attempt to correct MRC gold standards according to their findings?

evidence: In this paper, we introduce a novel framework to characterise machine reading comprehension gold standards. This framework has potential applications when comparing different gold standards, considering the design choices for a new gold standard and performing qualitative error analyses for a proposed approach.

title: A Framework for Evaluation of Machine Reading Comprehension Gold Standards
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents describe an evaluation framework and findings regarding MRC gold standards, including issues with factual correctness, lexical cues, and annotation artifacts. However, none of the documents explicitly state that any attempt has been made to correct the MRC gold standards based on these findings. While the authors propose future research goals (e.g., introducing semantic-altering grammatical modifiers), they do not indicate that corrections have been implemented.
